# `hk util no-commit-to-branch`

- **Usage:** `hk util no-commit-to-branch [--branch… <BRANCH>]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Prevent commits to specific branches

## Flags

- **`--branch… <BRANCH>`** — Branch names to protect (default: main, master)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
